connection_condition: tab04.fld004 corresponds to tab02.fld004; every transaction station exists in the station table.
description: A transaction takes place at a gas station and cannot exist without one.

connection_condition: tab04.fld007 corresponds to tab03.fld007; every transaction product exists in the product table.

connection_condition: tab01.fld002 carries the customer's segment value on the customer record.
description: Each customer is classified into one customer segment.

connection_condition: tab01.fld003 carries the customer's currency value on the customer record.
description: Each customer pays in one currency; currency is a customer-level attribute.

connection_condition: tab02.fld006 carries the station's country on the station record.
description: Each gas station is located in one country.

connection_condition: tab02.fld002 carries the station's segment on the station record.
description: Each gas station belongs to one market segment.

connection_condition: tab03.fld008 describes the product identified by tab03.fld007.
description: A product description is part of a product record and cannot exist without the product.

connection_condition: tab04.fld010 is the date attribute of a transaction line.
description: Each transaction occurs on one calendar date.

connection_condition: tab04.fld011 is the time attribute of a transaction line.
description: Each transaction occurs at one time of day.
